intro: Gentlemen, Gameweek 3 gave us Liverpool winning 2-0 at Ipswich, Arsenal beating Chelsea 2-1, and a Fulham 2-3 Crystal Palace thriller that Louie's man King still managed to haul in. Man City nicked a 1-0 against Coventry and Forest and Spurs shared a goalless draw. Asher topped the week with 48 and stays top on 169, a full 22 clear. Josh propped up the week with 22 and dropped two places to sixth. Jonny (43) went second, and Louie (also 43) jumped two places to fourth. Ben slipped to third. Absolute scenes at the top, squeaky bum time for Josh.
motw: Asher, 48 points and never in doubt. Gakpo got 11 with two assists, Gvardiol 8 and Donnarumma 7. He is now 22 clear on 169, which is less a title race and more a victory lap. The rest of you are playing for second.
stinker: Josh, 22 points and a drop from fourth to sixth. His best player was a goalkeeper, and the best of his outfielders was Rice with 5. Dedić and Silva each got 1 point after both came in off the waiver wire this week. Both conceded two. Set and forget is not a strategy when you keep forgetting to set.
bench: Ben, Asher and Brahmes share this one, each leaving 14 points on the bench. Ben left Sels (6) and Šeško (5) there, and Brahmes parked Pedro Porro (7) and Kinsky (6) in the stands. Asher sat N.Williams on 7 while starting Khalaili on 3. The bench is where points go to die, gentlemen, and three of you dug the graves.
bench_jam: Louie, take a bow. Shaw came on for Bruno G. via the auto-sub and returned 4 points, with an assist, a yellow card and 8 defensive contributions to his name. Not a worldie, but it beats a blank. Sometimes the best signing is the one the system makes for you.
red_card: Josh again, because of course. Thiaw scored an own goal for Newcastle in their 2-2 with Bournemouth and ended on -1. Josh already had a bad week and now he has a defender scoring for the other lot. Somebody check the group chat for a hospital ball.
gloves: Jack's Pickford takes the gloves with a single point. Everton conceded twice against Man Utd and he made one save. Jack owns a keeper on 1 point, a Sunday League performance that did nothing for Quantum of Tzolis. Still fifth, so he can live with it.

xi.350: A.Becker kept a clean sheet for Liverpool with 5 saves and 8 points. Josh's only decent return of the week, and it still wasn't enough.
xi.391: Gvardiol got a clean sheet, 2 bonus and 8 points for Asher. Rock solid, as ever, in his pocket.
xi.388: Guéhi matched him with 8 points, a clean sheet and 2 bonus for Louie. Man City defenders are the new set and forget.
xi.469: N.Williams got 7 for Forest's clean sheet, and he sat on Asher's bench. Asher has points to spare, so he can afford the generosity.
xi.367: Gakpo had 11 with two assists and a clean sheet for Asher. Absolute scenes from the lad.
xi.68: Tavernier scored and got 3 bonus for 10 points despite Bournemouth conceding twice. Ben's bright spot in a week of benched points.
xi.15: Ødegaard scored and got 3 bonus for 10 points in 76 minutes. Jonny will take that and go home early.
xi.69: Scott's two assists got him 10 points for Jonny, and he sat on the bench. Jonny picked him up this week and then forgot to play him. Brilliant.
xi.268: King scored for Fulham in a 3-2 defeat and got 10 points for Louie thanks to 3 bonus. Lost the match, won the gameweek.
xi.379: Isak scored twice in 63 minutes, got 3 bonus and 13 points, the top score of the week. Jonny's differential is now everybody's problem.
xi.411: Haaland scored and got 3 bonus for 9 points. Business as usual, and Louie is buzzing.
